## Fix 1: globals.css — Add missing Webflow base styles

1. Add `font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.75;` to the existing `body` block.
2. Add img base rule after the body block:
   ```css
   img {
     max-width: 100%;
     vertical-align: middle;
     display: inline-block;
   }
   ```

### Change after the `@layer base` closing brace:

3. Add reduced-motion media query block:
   ```css
   @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
     html {
       scroll-behavior: auto;
     }
   }
   ```

---

## Fix 2: layout.tsx — Add OG image + JSON-LD structured data

Edit `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Boldteq/src/app/layout.tsx`

### 2a. Extend the metadata export

Add `images` arrays to existing `openGraph` and `twitter` objects:
```ts
openGraph: {
  type: "website",
  siteName: SITE_CONFIG.name,
  locale: "en_US",
  images: [{ url: "/images/webflow/Group-47047.png", width: 1200, height: 630 }],
},
twitter: {
  card: "summary_large_image",
  images: ["/images/webflow/Group-47047.png"],
},
```

### 2b. Add JSON-LD `<script>` inside `<html>` before `<body>`

Add `<head>` element containing two JSON-LD scripts:

**Organization schema:**
```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Organization",
  "name": "Boldteq",
  "url": "https://boldteq.com",
  "logo": "https://boldteq.com/images/webflow/Group-47047.png",
  "foundingDate": "2024",
  "founder": {
    "@type": "Person",
    "name": "Yash Baldha"
  },
  "contactPoint": {
    "@type": "ContactPoint",
    "email": "sales@boldteq.com",
    "contactType": "sales"
  },
  "sameAs": [
    "https://www.linkedin.com/company/boldteq",
    "https://www.trustpilot.com/review/boldteq.com"
  ]
}
```

**FAQPage schema** (built from FAQ_ITEMS from faq.ts — all 8 items):
```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "FAQPage",
  "mainEntity": [
    // one Question entry per FAQ_ITEMS item
    {
      "@type": "Question",
      "name": "<question>",
      "acceptedAnswer": {
        "@type": "Answer",
        "text": "<answer>"
      }
    },
    ...
  ]
}
```

Implementation: import `FAQ_ITEMS` from `@/lib/constants/faq`, build the JSON strings at module level (not inside JSX), inject via `<script type="application/ld+json" dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: ... }} />`.
